stem: Based on the locations of the oil fields, which statement MOST LIKELY describes the environmental conditions in Texas millions of years ago?

options.label: A
options.text: Texas was once covered by a dry desert.

options.label: B
options.text: Texas was once covered by a shallow sea.

options.label: C
options.text: Texas was once covered by a flat grassland.

options.label: D
options.text: Texas was once covered by a tropical rain forest.
